```python
cumsum(x, axis=0, reverse=False) -> 'core.SymbolicTensor'
```

Part of [`evoxc.ops`](/api/evoxc/ops/)

Cumulative sum along an axis (numpy `cumsum` semantics plus an
optional reverse scan direction).

## Parameters

- `x` — `SymbolicTensor` or Python scalar.

- `axis` — int; scan axis.

- `reverse` — bool; scan from the end toward the start.

## Returns

- `'core.SymbolicTensor'` — `SymbolicTensor` with the same shape and dtype as `x` (numpy `cumsum` dtype rule: bool → int64, else preserved).
